title: Bimanual manipulation lab
phase_label: Local placement, hand-off, drawer and ACT pilots
summary: Build the foundations. Learn the mechanics. Keep every result inspectable.

milestones.title: Preparation
milestones.detail: Native runtime, rendered lab, evidence, portal, and lessons validated locally.

milestones.title: Physical foundation
milestones.detail: Contact placement, bar hand-off and passive drawer opening run locally. Utensil retrieval, plate/cup handling and unified scene remain.

milestones.title: Learned workflow
milestones.detail: Real-data ACT training runs on CPU/MPS and guarded learned rollouts execute. First rollout failed; full learned workflow, planning and recovery remain.

milestones.title: Intel / hackathon release
milestones.detail: Requires a working learned system and actual Core Ultra access.

milestones.title: Production hardening
milestones.detail: Broader held-out tests, fault handling, reproducibility, and operations.

blockers.title: Intel machine access
blockers.detail: BM-PTL Series 3 request submitted, Pending Review. Catalog offers Windows 11; host execution remains untested.

blockers.title: Remaining event details
blockers.detail: Confirm assets/seeds, pouring scope, prior-code eligibility and interactive hosting interpretation. Deadline and presentation requirements verified.

lessons.title: Observe, act, and step time
lessons.detail: Explore a real MuJoCo trajectory and distinguish action from observation.

lessons.title: Frames and reachable positions
lessons.detail: Use an interactive two-link sketch to see why a target can be unreachable.

lessons.title: Contacts, grasps, and hand-offs
lessons.detail: Identify the physical evidence required for a grasp and a hand-off.

lessons.title: Demonstrations and ACT
lessons.detail: Learn how aligned demonstrations support bounded imitation learning.

lessons.title: Supervision and recovery
lessons.detail: Separate visual planning, action policy, and the supervisor that may stop.

lessons.title: Evaluation and uncertainty
lessons.detail: Freeze evaluation conditions and interpret task results honestly.

lessons.title: OpenVINO and benchmarks
lessons.detail: Measure actual device use and end-to-end timing on the Intel target.
